# ebaycli monorepo

A local TypeScript eBay seller CLI with an optional deployment-owned TypeScript Cloudflare Worker OAuth relay.

## Start here

- [CLI usage](cli/README.md)
- [Examples](cli/examples/README.md)

- [Local profiles](docs/profiles.md)

- [Cloudflare deployment](docs/deployment.md)
- [Code map](docs/code-map.md)
- [Contribution guide](CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [Testing](TESTING.md)

## Runtime discovery

Use `ebay guide --json` and `ebay llms` to inspect the installed CLI's workflows and listing inputs. From source, build with `npm --prefix cli run build` and invoke `node cli/dist/index.js guide --json`.

The CLI owns local profiles, seller sessions, and direct listing/setup workflows. A compatible relay handles OAuth login and refresh using each deployment's eBay app credentials. The Worker reference deploys directly to Cloudflare Workers with D1 temporary auth-state storage. No shared public auth mode or embedded eBay app secret is provided.

The current package is a local CLI, with separate agent configuration directories recommended for concurrent sellers or workers. Named profiles are selectors, not hosted tenant isolation. OAuth login is account consent; review listing plans and authorize account changes before applying them. Consult the support matrix and testing guide for fixture-based coverage and live-account limitations.
